title: Completed pullback linearity and descent of comparisons to raw fractions
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $g:X'\to X$ be a morphism between noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. On their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_W=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_W$ for $W=X,X'$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use module sheaves and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and sheaf tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $c_g:g^{-1}B_X\to B_{X'}$ be the projection-defined map of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and put $P_gK=B_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}B_X}g^{-1}K$. Put $E_W=B_W[1/\varpi]$, the sheaf localization [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization], and let $\mathcal C_W$ be the full completed constructible subcategory including compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and $Q_W:\mathcal C_W\to\mathcal R_W=\mathcal C_W[1/\varpi]$ its raw scalar localization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $J_W:\mathcal R_W\to D(E_W)$ be the specified functor with $J_W(Q_WK)=E_W\otimes^L_{B_W}K$ and $J_W(f/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}(E_W\otimes^L_{B_W}f)$ [lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor]. Assume that $P_g$ maps $\mathcal C_X$ to $\mathcal C_{X'}$ and that the specified natural $\gamma_{g,K}:P_gK\to\widehat P_gK$ is invertible for $K\in\mathcal C_X$. Then the coefficient map preserves every constant $A$-scalar and both restricted functors $P_g,\widehat P_g:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal C_{X'}$ are $A$-linear [def-weil-linear-category, def-weil-linear-functor]. In particular
$$\widehat P_g(f)=\gamma_{g,L}P_g(f)\gamma_{g,K}^{-1},\qquad \overline P_g(f/\varpi^n)=\widehat P_g(f)/\varpi^n$$
defines a functor $\overline P_g:\mathcal R_X\to\mathcal R_{X'}$ with object $Q_{X'}\widehat P_gK$. The latter fraction formula is independent of representatives even when integral morphism modules have $\varpi$-torsion: the relation $f/\varpi^n=h/\varpi^m$ is equivalent to $\varpi^r(\varpi^m f-\varpi^n h)=0$ for some $r\geq0$, and its image satisfies the same annihilating-power relation. Sums and compositions are the corresponding fraction operations.
Let $H(K)=J_{X'}(Q_{X'}\widehat P_gK)$ and $G(K)=E_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}E_X}g^{-1}(J_XQ_XK)$ on integral objects and maps. The functor $H$ extends by $J_{X'}\overline P_g$; $G$ extends by the same displayed expression with $J_X$ on $\mathcal R_X$. For either extension $F$, $F(f/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}F(f)$. Every natural transformation $\beta:H\to G$ on $\mathcal C_X$ extends uniquely with the same components to these raw rationalized functors. Explicitly
$$G(f/\varpi^n)\beta_K=\varpi^{-n}G(f)\beta_K=\varpi^{-n}\beta_LH(f)=\beta_LH(f/\varpi^n).$$
If every $\beta_K$ is invertible, the descended transformation is a natural isomorphism. No full faithfulness of $J_W$ is required.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 and Section 6.8 rationalization; explicit completed-pullback linearity and raw-fraction descent (agent elaboration)

proof.text: Compare the two maps from the inverse image of the constant A-sheaf to the completed coefficient sheaf after every finite quotient projection. The constant inverse-image map is natural in the quotient map A → A/(varpi^(n+1)), and the finite coefficient comparison is defined using this map. Cancel the level presentation isomorphisms and use the constant-to-completion projection equation. Joint monicity of the limit projections proves coefficient_constants. Neither preservation of this limit nor invertibility of its structural map is used.

proof.text: Use the constant-section linearity of the existing actual derived direct image from lem-pbc-scalar-constructible-operation-restriction. The published ordinary derived pullback is its left adjoint. The linear-adjunction Hom bijection gives additivity and A-linearity of this exact specified ordinary pullback. Restrict it using hP and pbcConditionalIntegral; the full-subcategory Hom actions are inherited.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 and Section 6.8 rationalization; explicit completed-pullback linearity and raw-fraction descent (agent elaboration)

proof.text: The integral constructible predicate is closed under isomorphisms by lem-weil-pbc-uniform-complete-triangulated. Transport hP along the assumed invertible completedPullbackComparison. The specified strict completed pullback unit is natural and has exactly these components, so it restricts to a natural isomorphism from ordinary to completed pullback. Transport addition and A-linearity along this isomorphism. Cancel its source component in the naturality equation to obtain the stated conjugation formula.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 and Section 6.8 rationalization; explicit completed-pullback linearity and raw-fraction descent (agent elaboration)

proof.text: Construct bar using the existing ScalarLocalization.transport of the A-linear completed restriction: its Hom map is LinearMap.baseChange. It is additive and localization-linear and has the literal prescribed object map. The baseChange formula on a pure tensor gives its formula on each fraction. Mathlib IsLocalization.tensorProduct_isLocalizedModule identifies the tensor-with-one map as module localization. Its mk'_eq_mk'_iff gives exactly the extra-power relation for fraction equality, without any torsion cancellation; mk'_add_mk' gives common-denominator addition. Apply the completed restriction to the annihilator equation to preserve the same r. Bilinearity of composition and functoriality of Q prove the composition formula.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 and Section 6.8 rationalization; explicit completed-pullback linearity and raw-fraction descent (agent elaboration)

proof.text: Activate the normalized module actions supplied by JY and JX. Evaluate each constant field scalar using the sheafification adjunction defining rationalModuleConstantMap. The adjunct of the specified rationalContinuousPullback is the given continuous precomposition map, so it preserves these constants. Thus module direct image is E-linear for precisely the supplied actions. Its module left adjoint is E-linear, and exact derived descent gives E-linearity of rationalPull. The canonical coefficient equivalence sends invSelf(varpi) to varpi^(-1), by its algebraMap equation and the inverse identity. Convert the localization-linear bar to E-linearity. Functor.map_smul for the two composites now gives H_fractions and G_fractions.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 and Section 6.8 rationalization; explicit completed-pullback linearity and raw-fraction descent (agent elaboration)

proof.text: Use the baseChange formula on 1 tensor f to identify the restriction of bar followed by JX with the integral completed functor followed by QX and JX on arrows. Keep the supplied beta components on every raw object. Prove naturality by tensor induction: the zero and sum cases use additivity; a pure tensor a tensor f is the field scalar corresponding to a times Q(f), so E-linearity and bilinear composition reduce to the integral naturality equation. Every raw object has its original integral object, so components give uniqueness. The prescribed transports and componentwise invertibility give invertibility of every component, hence of the natural transformation. No faithfulness hypothesis or existence choice is used.
